HediffDef.label: elemental synchronization
HediffDef.description: Two allied, transformed Ascendants struck the same enemy within four seconds while within eight clear cells of each other. Their coordination grants 10% more melee damage and movement for four seconds. Each participant can synchronize once per six seconds; multiple partners do not stack this condition. Earth partners add a brief ward, Water partners repair up to four ordinary injury points each, Water/Lightning can cause a resisted discharge, and Flame/Wind strengthens one existing hit by 15%. No extra damage packet is spawned.

HediffDef.label: sovereign synchronization
HediffDef.description: Coordinated by a Celestial, or an Eclipse empowered by an actual eclipse. Grants 15% more melee damage and movement for four seconds, replacing ordinary elemental synchronization. The shared six-second participant cooldown and elemental support rules still apply. This does not stack with the weaker synchronization condition.

HediffDef.label: stone concord ward
HediffDef.description: An Earth or Adamant partner lends stone protection after a synchronized impact. Reduces remaining incoming damage by 15% for four seconds. One ward per pawn; additional partners do not stack copies.
